headline: Reviewed personnel actions including hires, transfers, and resignations for Lewiston Public Schools staff.
summary: The committee reviewed a consent agenda listing new hires, transfers, resignations, and rescinded positions for Lewiston Public Schools staff. There was no public input, and the meeting adjourned.
